title: Chapter 168
text:
"When you return to the Southern Continent, I'll tell you the details of the plan. I do need your strength …" Bennett paused. "Stardragon was the first to agree to the material aid, and you participated in the Battle of Tedramira River. I owe you one."

"Just give me something in return."

Bennett laughed. "That's your style. We'll talk about it when you return to the Southern Continent."

You have triggered the C-level mission [Deterrence]!

Mission Introduction: Some of the officials in Maple are very corrupt. It's time to let them know that holding onto the money can only get them bullets. We're not robbers, but we don't mind playing the role once in a while.

Mission Requirements: Enter the mansions of the five target officials and leave behind the evidence collected by the Dark Net.

Reward: 120000 EXP, 500 favorability with the Dark Net.

No special reward. Looks like a normal mission. I'll just do it casually. Han Xiao nodded. He was the best at infiltrating.

The transport plane was refueled and took off with Han Xiao. A few hours later, they arrived at a plain dozens of miles away from a novice village. It was not easy to find an airport in the wilderness. The wings of the transport plane were equipped with steerable jets to provide vertical take-off and landing power. They could land in the wilderness and did not have to worry about not having a runway when they took off. The pilot was also experienced.

If Han Xiao did not have the huge discount from his old customers, the price of the chartered plane would have been a few times more expensive. Legendary Points and faction relationships saved him a lot of money. Relationships were very important.

After getting off the plane, Han Xiao arrived at the novice village. The players there were busy completing missions. When they saw Black Phantom, they were all stunned and surprised. They swarmed forward and surrounded Han Xiao.

…

Poseidon, a core member of the Guild of Gods, was humming a tune and browsing the forum posts. He was in a good mood. President Jupiter finally stopped worrying about the A-level mission, and the development of the guild was on the right track.

The second episode of 'Galaxy Times' invited a beautiful eSports player, Rainstorm Club's top player, Rainy Jiang, to share her experience and briefly introduce Stardragon.

She participated in the Battle of Tedramira River and gave him some insider information, including the information of the Germinal Organization's withdrawal. That was how Jupiter found out that the Germinal Organization's base in Southern Continent had been dismantled. Thus, he completely gave up on the A-level mission. Coincidentally, the Dark Crow Valley faction had been removed, and he could join other factions. Therefore, he focused on organizing the guild and developing in Southern Continent.

The second issue of Galaxy Times invited professional players from different novice planets for interviews. These professional players all opened maps and joined different factions, allowing the players to learn more about the various planets. The conflict between the Six Nations and the Germinal Organization was gradually revealed. The Blue Star players all understood that this was the main storyline of the planet.

Poseidon did not agree with the A-level mission of the Germinal Organization from the beginning. He felt that it would distract the core group. Fortunately, Jupiter changed his mind and gave up on the A-level mission. Instead, the club's professional team was interested in this mission. Professional players were capable of challenging difficult missions, so the guild reported the process of triggering the mission to the team.

After some discussion, the club decided to choose a quasi-first-rate player to descend to Andrea and look for the Germinal Organization to trigger the A-level mission. The guild would provide resources and intelligence support to help the player complete the mission. If the player really succeeded, the club would have another account with potential. Even if the player did not succeed, it would not be a loss.

The player was the face of the club, and famous players had a higher status than the guild. The quasi-first-rate player was also quite famous. When he came to the guild office to chat, Poseidon asked for a few autographs and was very happy.

Furthermore, the club was very satisfied with them for triggering the A-level mission in the novice stage and gave them some bonuses.

The bad luck of the guild was over, and Poseidon was in a good mood.

Speaking of the development of the guild, Black Phantom had to be mentioned. Most of the members of the Guild of Gods were born in Southern Continent. With the support of the guild, they all benefited from Black Phantom. Black Phantom only appeared in Southern Continent, which gave the players of Southern Continent a huge advantage, and the guild also benefited a lot.

Many of their opponents were born in other continents, and the Guild of Gods was ahead of them, so the situation was very good.

The core members of the Guild of Gods were secretly delighted when they heard the envious and jealous remarks of their old rivals. They felt a sense of superiority.

Suddenly, a large number of new posts appeared in the Blue Star section of the forum, and the content could be summarized into one sentence.

"Black Phantom has come to Western Continent!"

Poseidon's heart skipped a beat, and he quickly opened the posts one by one. After reading them, he was sweating profusely. The little bit of joy in his heart disappeared, and he could not believe it.

"Is Black Phantom going to go to all the novice villages?"

If that was the case, all the players would be equal, and the advantage of the guild would be gone.

Poseidon hurriedly informed the president and the other core members in the channel, and they were all shocked.

Jupiter was very calm. He pondered and said, "You can't say that. We learned the skills in advance and can complete missions with more rewards, so we still have a small advantage. The behavior of NPCs is uncontrollable, so don't force it."

Since the president said so, everyone was relieved. Poseidon looked at the forum again and suddenly exclaimed, "F * ck, look at this post!"

"What?" Jupiter opened the post in confusion. The content was a screenshot of the skills taught by Han Xiao, and the focus was on the [Energy Training Technique]. Seeing the effect of the skill, everyone's jaw dropped.

"Godly skill!"

Energy was a key attribute, and it directly affected one's combat power. Now that the new players lacked energy, they could not support the consumption of their Esper abilities, and Espers needed this skill the most!

Jupiter was an Esper. He was envious, but he suddenly realized a serious problem. "Wait, Black Phantom did not teach this skill in the Southern Continent!"

Everyone was dumbfounded.

Could it be that the more Black Phantom went to the novice villages, the better the rewards were? So, the Southern Continent players were at a disadvantage?

What the f * ck, this is not superior, it's unlucky!

The core members of the Guild of Gods were frustrated.

Why is this feeling of being unlucky so familiar … It's back, everything is back!

…

On the forum, the Western Continent players were jumping up and down like stray dogs that had taken aphrodisiac, showing off. They had been suppressed by the Southern Continent players for so long, and now it was the Southern Continent players' turn to feel bad. The opportunity that they thought was unique to them turned out to be available to everyone.

Especially when they saw the new skill [Energy Training Technique] taught by Black Phantom, the Western Continent players were overjoyed, and the Southern Continent players were tired and upset.

Every dog has its day, and the Southern Continent players were the ones who were envious and jealous.

"So angry, why didn't Black Phantom have this skill before?"

"I want to learn it so much."

"Isn't he a mechanic instructor? How can he have such an awesome skill? Even I, an Esper, am tempted!"

Other than the boasting and complaining posts, Black Phantom's appearance in the Western Continent also caused the players to speculate. It looked like he was going to visit all the novice villages. Could it be that Black Phantom was actually an official novice guide? But the other novice planets did not. However, people's imaginations were endless. Once they decided on a result, they would find all kinds of reasons to prove it. There were endless guesses. Occasionally, players from other novice planets would come to the Blue Star forum and complain about the unfairness. The Blue Star had a novice guide to destroy the balance of the game, but it would soon be drowned by the sea of people.

The biggest supporters of this theory were the players from the Northern Continent and Andrea. Looking at Black Phantom's actions, it might be their turn next. They could not wait to show their faces in front of Black Phantom. Do you see our little expectant eyes? Hurry up and come!

The players from the Western Continent were like celebrating a festival. Some players who had left the novice village to explore the map heard the news of Black Phantom's arrival and rushed back to their original novice village to wait for Black Phantom's arrival.

[Energy Training Technique] had become a hot topic. Not only were there players who wanted to change their professions, even Mutants were eager to learn this skill. Although the price was high, for this godly skill, they were willing to sacrifice everything to learn it!
